name: Hyperphallic
source: Explore the romantic and sexual escapades of a ditzy office worker and his hyper-hung crush. Will they seize the opportunities the Pleasure District offers, or surrender to its corruption?
translation: 一个迷迷糊糊的上班族暗恋上了一个男人，对方的家伙大得惊人。来体验这两人的恋爱与性爱奇遇吧。他们会抓住欢愉区提供的种种机会，还是会屈服于其中的腐化？
